{
  "type": "module",
  "name": "Buildplace",
  "description": "Buildplace Repository.",
  "main": "app.ts",
  "directories": {
    "test": "test"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx watch --tsconfig ./api/tsconfig.json --inspect ./api/src/server.ts --dev",
    "dev:host": "tsx watch --tsconfig ./api/tsconfig.json ./api/src/server.ts --dev --host",
    "dev:init": "pnpm install && pnpm prisma generate && pnpm codegen && pnpm prisma migrate reset && pnpm dev",
    "test": "vitest",
    "test:linux": "xvfb-run vitest",
    "test:run": "vitest run",
    "test:coverage": "vitest run --coverage --browser.headless",
    "start": "pnpm prisma migrate deploy && node --import ./dist/instrumentation/index.js dist/server.js",
    "build": "pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web",
    "build:api": "pnpm prisma generate && tsup",
    "build:web": "vite build",
    "lint": "biome check api test && biome check web test && biome check shared test",
    "lint:fix": "biome check api test --write && biome check web test --write && biome check shared test --write",
    "codegen": "tsx --tsconfig ./api/tsconfig.json ./api/lib/graphql/codegen.ts && pnpm gql-tada generate output",
    "codegen:watch": "tsx watch --clear-screen=false --exclude '*' --include './dist/server.js' --tsconfig ./api/tsconfig.json ./api/lib/graphql/codegen.ts",
    "generate": "tsx --tsconfig ./scripts/tsconfig.json ./scripts/cli/generate/index.tsx",
    "codeMod": "tsx --tsconfig ./scripts/tsconfig.json ./scripts/cli/codeMod/index.tsx",
    "dataMigration": "tsx --tsconfig ./scripts/tsconfig.json ./scripts/cli/dataMigration/index.tsx",
    "setupDb": "tsx --tsconfig ./scripts/tsconfig.json ./scripts/setupDb.ts",
    "prepare": "husky"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": "24.15.0"
  },
  "devEngines": {
    "runtime": {
      "name": "node",
      "version": "24.15.0",
      "onFail": "download"
    }
  },
  "prisma": {
    "seed": "tsx --tsconfig ./scripts/tsconfig.json ./scripts/seeding/seed.ts"
  },
